title: ואדי אל־עין - מנזר ביזאנטי (Wadi el-ʿEin, Byzantine monastery)
author: N. Tanin (Benjamin survey)
location_note: Cliff east of el-Bira above Wadi el-ʿEin, a northern tributary of Nahal Mikhmas.

features.subtype: three rock-cut hermit cells in the cliff, 5-7 m up
small plastered channels of the water-collection system
three plastered rock-cut cisterns at the foot of the cliff and a cistern roofed with built arches

title: ענתא (ʿAnata)
author: U. Dinur (Benjamin survey)
location_note: Village north-east of Jerusalem and its surroundings (about 1 km2).
notes: CLAIM: identification of ʿAnata with biblical Anathoth. A Roman tomb exposed in 1936 is earlier work (not coded).

features.subtype: rock-cut Roman tomb with decorated facade
shaft tombs among ten tombs in the upper wadi (one shaft tomb measured)
features.quote: מהם ארבעה קברי פיר מתקופת הב״ת א׳

features.subtype: Byzantine arcosolium tomb; underground system of five rooms partly used for burial (perhaps the church crypt)
cisterns on the slopes and the west hill (some reused in the underground system)
rock-cut winepresses (one with cupmarks, one with two beam niches); agricultural installations
features.period: winepresses not dated; installations Byzantine and Arab

title: ירושלים, שער האשפות (Jerusalem, Dung Gate)
author: D. Bahat
location_note: Dung Gate and Western Wall plaza; no map reference.
notes: Late Mamluk-Ottoman residential quarter; a Crusader installation known only from a mosaic fragment. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים, אבו טור (Jerusalem, Abu Tor)
author: H. Goldfus, Z. M. Gozlan
notes: Ottoman house with tabuns built over a Byzantine church. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: דיר מוכליק - כתובות יווניות (Deir Mukallik, Greek inscriptions)
author: Y. Patrich (cave survey)
location_note: Near Deir Mukallik (Theoctistus monastery) in Nahal Og (Wadi Mukallik); no map reference; located by the text (Nahal Og, gazetteer Z3).
screen_note: Heading not in the gazetteer; flagged by a map reference of a neighbouring report; the text names Nahal Og (gazetteer Z3). Not a held area.
notes: Eight Christian Greek inscriptions and crosses cut in the rock above the cistern.

features.subtype: domed cistern (6.8 x 6 m) with mosaic-paved platform on the main path to the monastery
features.quote: מעל בור מים המצוי על שביל הגישה העיקרי
הבור ניזון מתעלה שאליה הוטו מי נגר

features.subtype: diversion wall turning runoff into the feeder channel
features.quote: על ידי קיר ,סוכר ששרידיו נראים סמוך

title: מערת אל־מציה (נחל דרגות עליון) (El-Mazia Cave, Upper Nahal Deragot)
author: Y. Patrich (cave survey)
location_note: Below the village of Zaʿatara; the two forts at 1757/1202 and 1759/1200.
notes: Two small forts, a built path and a wall down to the wadi, probably a defence system for the cave occupants in the Bar Kokhba revolt (author's suggestion; buildings not coded).

features.subtype: natural cave c. 100 m long with halls and a dripping spring; jars, cooking pots, glass, uninscribed parchment, textiles, infant's sandal, three coins of Alexander Jannaeus
features.period: main use like the Bar Kokhba caves; coins show use already in the Second Temple period
features.quote: שנעשה במערה שימוש עוד בזמן קדום ,יותר בתקופת בית

title: עין גדי (ʿEn Gedi, Nahal ʿArugot aqueduct and tombs)
author: G. Hadas
location_note: Aqueduct in Nahal ʿArugot; no map reference.

features.subtype: two tombs by the aqueduct: chamber with standing pit and blocking stone, wooden (palm-wood) coffins
features.period: first tomb mid-2nd to mid-1st c. BCE; second probably 1st c. BCE
features.quote: נראה שהקבר שימש מאמצע המאה 'הב ועד אמצע המאה הא׳

features.subtype: Nahal ʿArugot aqueduct, built over the tombs
features.quote: שבניית האמה מאוחרת לתקופת השימוש ,בקברים וזמנה
